```lean
induction' h with
| refl => 
  have h_refl : r a b := AddConGen.Rel.refl h
  exact hr a b h_refl
| add h1 h2 => 
  have h1' : AddConGen.Rel r (star a) (star b) := 
    by apply @AddConGen.Rel.add _ _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2
  have h2' : AddConGen.Rel r (star a) (star b) := 
    by apply @AddConGen.Rel.add _ _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2
  exact AddConGen.Rel.add h1' h2'
| star h => 
  have h' : AddConGen.Rel r a b := 
    by apply @AddConGen.Rel.star _ _ _ _ _ _ h
  exact @AddConGen.Rel.star _ _ _ _ _ _ h'
```
